map.根据宠物体型计算寄养所需面积、犬舍/猫舍尺寸与活动空间: Calculate the area needed for boarding, plus kennel or cattery dimensions and activity space, from your pet’s size
map.📖 查看「宠物寄养空间计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the Pet Boarding Space Calculator user guide
map.寄养面积标准：犬舍面积 = 单只犬舍面积 × 数量（小型犬不低于 4 ㎡/只）；: Boarding area standards: kennel area = single-dog kennel area × number (not less than 4 m² per small dog); activity area = activity standard × (when the number is greater than 1, a sharing factor of 1 + (number − 1) × 0.7 applies); total area = kennel area + activity area; cats are counted separately by cattery and activity standards.
map.📚 深度解析：宠物寄养空间计算器: 📚 In-depth analysis: Pet Boarding Space Calculator
map.家庭多犬临时寄养规划：按犬的体型（小型/中型/大型/巨型）取单舍面积与活动区，工: Planning temporary boarding for several dogs at home: take the single-kennel area and activity area by dog size (small / medium / large / giant) and the tool works out the total footprint of N individual kennels plus the shared activity area, so you can free up rooms in advance.
map.猫舍多猫分区：猫单体面积远小于犬，但需配置猫砂区与垂直活动空间，工具按猫体型给出: Zoning a cattery for several cats: a single cat needs far less area than a dog, but a litter area and vertical space are required; the tool gives the single-cage and activity areas by cat size.
Enlarging the activity area for long stays (over 14 days): long-term confinement needs more exercise space, so the tool applies an extra 1.2 factor to the activity area, indicating that a larger exercise ground is needed.
map.算例：中型犬 ×3 只、寄养 20 天: Worked example: 3 medium dogs, 20 days of boarding
map.面积标准依据什么？: What are the area standards based on?
map.犬舍单体 4–12 ㎡、猫笼 1.5–2.5 ㎡为常见家庭/小型寄养参考值，随体: A single kennel of 4–12 m² and a cat cage of 1.5–2.5 m² are common reference values for households and small boarding facilities, increasing with body size; when several animals share the activity area a diminishing factor applies (each extra animal adds 0.5 times) so the figure does not grow without limit, keeping both exercise and space efficiency.
map.为什么长期寄养要扩大活动区？: Why does long-term boarding need a larger activity area?
map.犬猫长期圈养易出现刻板行为与应激，活动空间不足会累积健康风险；>14 天判定为长: Dogs and cats kept in long-term confinement easily develop stereotypic behaviour and stress, and insufficient space accumulates health risks; stays over 14 days count as long-term, so the extra ×1.2 on the activity area signals that more walking or roaming space is needed. This tool is a planning reference; actual facilities must comply with local husbandry and animal welfare rules.
